doc: fx_colour.py families: files = PNG name prefixes in the weapon FX folder; tokens = palette token -> the sheet's colour (r2_w4_fx_colour.jpg). Tokens not listed keep their colour (the ink outline always stays ink).

families.note: a thin hot-yellow streak, light orange tail (the sheet's SMG rounds)

the first blast frame: its burst was paper with a vermilion core, so the explosion family printed a white star round an orange heart; r2_w4 wants the white-hot core inside the orange-yellow, so this frame swaps them (applied after explosion, which it overrides)
acid green (iteration 5: ink_2 and wash brightened; the rings printed a dull olive at 32 px/m)
pale crystal, cyan-white glint (teal is souls only)

n5-look iteration 8 (r2_w4): the smoke ring was painted orange whole (wash -> orange); the sheet has dark smoke with the fire inside it, so this frame takes dark smoke and an orange band along the ring's inner edge (inner.px part px; tools/art/fx_colour.py inner_band). Drop this family = before. Iteration 10: pockets (r2_w4: ragged fire pockets, not a ring): 9 round orange pockets with a hot yellow core moved toward the blast centre (core_in; centred, it read as a target), hash-placed on the ring's inner edge, clipped to the smoke (fx_colour.py pockets); when present they replace the inner band. Drop pockets = the iteration 8 band. Iteration 11: wobble 0.2 (a hashed 3- and 5-lobe radial wobble of each pocket edge, r2_w4's ragged fire tongues; 0 = the round iteration 10 pockets) with r_px 30-52 (was 25-45: the lumpy edge eats fire area).
